scripts.dev: npm run build -w @private-chat/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @private-chat/contracts" "npm run dev -w @private-chat/server" "npm run dev -w @private-chat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @private-chat/contracts && npm run build -w @private-chat/web && npm run build -w @private-chat/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @private-chat/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @private-chat/contracts && npm run test -w @private-chat/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages db package.json tsconfig.base.json railway.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages db package.json tsconfig.base.json railway.json
